$comment: Baseline for the website-bundle-size check (warn-only). Asset names are content-hash-normalized (About.DvK3R9p1.css → About.*.css) so rebuilds compare stably. A local run ratchets totalBytes down when dist/ shrinks. Raising it is FINE without asking, unlike most allowlists here: delete this file and run `pnpm check bundle-size` against a fresh build to regenerate. The warn at the moment of growth is the signal; the number is only a record of where the bundle stands.
